Package com.egradx.files.storage

Class EgradxS3BlobStore

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.files.storage.EgradxS3BlobStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
EgradxBlobStore
public class EgradxS3BlobStore extends Object implements EgradxBlobStore
Files in an S3-compatible bucket, through the AWS SDK v2: AWS S3 itself, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, … Works with several instances as they are. Failures surface as IOException, as the local store's do.
